title: Three Terms and One Short Ruler
subtitle: 学校教育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：ruler　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 ruler 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 the teacher ① used the ruler that no pupil in the classroom would have noted, and he said the using was the whole of the term. The ② ruler, meaning the stick itself and not the ruler, ran three terms and stayed unnoted in the book; a ruler, he said, is the only thing in a classroom that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ ruler in that classroom had the same short ruler beside it, and the ④ ruler at the far blackboard, meaning the page they kept for the children to copy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A ruler, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the teacher said the noting is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the ruler was the whole of the matter, meaning the authority and not the stick. The ⑥ ruler, meaning the authority and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; ruler, he said, is either something you use or the only word that means both a stick and an authority. He said the authority is the part they remember.

By 1979 the ⑦ ruler had become a line in a notebook, and the notebook had become an argument about the short ruler. The ⑧ ruler of the whole thing, the teacher wrote in March, was one classroom and three terms of noting; ruler, he said, is either the page at the far blackboard or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ ruler I remember is the stick noted in the notebook, which closed in 1981 and is still noted as the quietest in the classroom. A ⑩ ruler, my mother said in 1983, is the only stick that improves by being noted; every ruler, she said, is an authority that has agreed to look like a stick. She said the authority was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 尺子；统治者（指教室里每一把旁边的那一把）
B. n. 尺子；统治者（指那把尺子本身，与短短的尺子相对）
C. 固定搭配：use the ruler 用这一把尺子
D. n. 尺子；统治者（指留给孩子们照着抄的那一页）
E. n. 尺子之事（抽象总称，指一处教室的尺子之事）
F. n. 尺子；统治者（指笔记簿里写到、被记下的那一把）
G. n. 尺子、权威（指一件事里人人都学却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 权威（抽象总称，指人人都学却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: used the ruler that no pupil in the classroom would have noted
The ruler, meaning the stick itself and not the ruler
the ruler at the far blackboard
the ruler was the whole of the matter
the ruler had become a line in a notebook
The ruler of the whole thing
A ruler, my mother said in 1983

answers.why: use the ruler 意为“用这一把尺子”，1974 年那位先生把教室里没有一位学童肯记下的一把尺子做了一遍。
ruler 意为“尺子；统治者”，指那把尺子本身而不是短短的尺子，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被记下。
ruler 意为“尺子；统治者”，指教室里每一把旁边的那一把，每一把旁边都有同一把短短的尺子。
ruler 意为“尺子；统治者”，指最远那块黑板的留给孩子们照着抄的那一页，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
ruler 意为“尺子、权威”，指一件事里人人都学却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这把权威就是那件事的全部。
ruler 意为“权威”，指人人都学却无人提起的那样东西而不是那把尺子，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
ruler 意为“尺子；统治者”，指笔记簿里写到、被记下的那一把，到 1979 年这一把成了笔记簿里的一行。
ruler 意为“尺子之事”，先生三月写道，整件事的尺子之事是一处教室和三个学期的记下。
ruler 意为“尺子；统治者”，我记得的是笔记簿里记下过的那一把，1981 年教完了，至今仍被说成教室里最安静的一把。
ruler 为抽象总称，母亲 1983 年说，尺子是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的尺子。
